reading.title: A Day at the Lake
reading.text: We got up early and watched the sun rise over the lake. The sky was clear and blue, and a few birds flew in the sky. At noon the sun was very hot, so we sat in the shade and drank cold juice. My brother did not put on cream and he got sunburnt on his nose! In the evening the sun set behind the hills, and the sky turned red and orange. It was the most beautiful sunset I have ever seen.

listening.title: Weather Report
listening.script: Good morning! Today we have a clear blue sky all over the country. The sun rises at six and sets at eight in the evening. It will be hot, so please sit in the shade at noon. Children, do not forget your hats, because you can get sunburnt very fast. Tomorrow the sky will be cloudy in the north.

reading.title: Camping Night
reading.text: Last summer we went camping in the mountains. At night the moon was full and very bright. We walked to the river by the light of the moon, and there were no street lamps at all. The stars were out, and my uncle showed me a bright star called the North Star. Suddenly I saw a shooting star! I made a wish, but I cannot tell you what it was. My sister counted the stars until she fell asleep.

listening.title: Space Club
listening.script: Every Friday our school has a Space Club. Last week we learned that the first people landed on the moon a long time ago. Our teacher says the moon rises later every night. We also learned that a star is not a small light, but a huge ball of fire. At the end, the teacher gave each of us a paper star. Next week we will watch the sky and count the stars together.

reading.title: A Rainy Saturday
reading.text: On Saturday it was pouring with rain, so we could not go to the park. Heavy rain fell all morning, and the streets were full of water. In the afternoon the rain stopped, and I went out with my umbrella. A little boy was playing in the rain, and he got very wet. His mother was not angry, because she had a big towel. My friend Anvar and I are lucky, because our football team plays rain or shine.

reading.title: The Big Storm
reading.text: At lunchtime dark clouds began to gather in the sky. Soon the sky was grey and the wind grew strong. Then we heard a loud clap of thunder, and a bright flash of lightning lit up our garden. My little sister hid under the table, but I told her, "Don't be afraid." The thunderstorm lasted for an hour. In the evening the clouds cleared, and a beautiful rainbow came out. We were very happy, and Dad made hot chocolate.

listening.title: Storm Safety
listening.script: When there is thunder and lightning, it is not safe to stand under a tall tree. Lightning often strikes tall things. Go inside a house and stay away from the windows. You can count the seconds between the flash and the thunder. If the clouds gather and the sky turns dark, listen to the radio. When the clouds clear, you can go out again.

reading.title: Winter Holiday
reading.text: This winter it snowed for three days. In the morning, the whole village was covered in snow. We went outside and built a big snowman with a carrot nose. Then we had a snowball fight, and I was hit on the back. On the pond there was thin ice, so Dad said, "Stay away from it." On Sunday we went to the ice rink and learned to skate. My brother slipped on the ice twice, but he laughed and tried again.

listening.title: Cold Drinks
listening.script: In summer I love cold drinks. Mum puts ice cubes in my juice. Yesterday I saw a man selling blocks of ice in the market. In winter things are different. reading.title: Kite Day
reading.text: On Sunday there was a light wind, so we took our kites to the field. At first the wind was too weak. Then a strong gust of wind came, and my kite flew high in the sky. Later the wind dropped, and thick fog came down. We could not see the other end of the field. We waited and played cards in the car. At eleven the fog lifted, and we saw the green hills again. It was a funny day.

listening.title: A Foggy Morning
listening.script: This morning there was dense fog in our town. I could not see the school from the bus stop. The bus driver drove very slowly, and the bus came late. At eleven the fog began to lift. After school, a strong wind began to blow, and it blew my scarf away. I ran after it against the wind! A kind lady caught it and gave it back to me.
